tool_args.rationale: The previous submission failed due to an undefined global parameter variable, not evidence against the mechanism. This executable model initializes and assigns _PARAMS in fit(), then numerically fits all four parameters to the five paid rows using the supplied barrier-modulated siphon law. The sink-gradient span is ample, so no probe is justified.
